Sonia Gandhi’s memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, has reignited the political debate over Operation Blue Star. Her account of Indira Gandhi’s fears following the 1984 military operation has drawn sharp criticism from BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal leaders.
